sentences.text: CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE G BASAVARAJA

ORAL ORDER Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for respondent No.1/State.
2.

The petitioners, who are accused Nos.2 and 3 in C.C. No.11680/2025 (arising out of Crime No.86/2025 of Women Police Station, Kalaburagi), pending on the file of I Additional Civil Judge and JMFC Court at Kalaburagi have filed this petition seeking the following reliefs:
"a) Quash the impugned proceedings in C.C. No.11680/2025 pending on the file of I Addl. Civil Judge & JMFC at Kalaburagi of Kalaburagi City Women P.S., for the offence under Sec.376(2)(n), 384, 504, 506, 109 R/w 34 of Indian Penal Code and Sec.67(A) of Information Technology Act, 2008 and the Order of cognizance dated 25.10.2025 arising out of Crime No.86/2025 as illegal and one without jurisdiction.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:2028 HC-KAR b) Pass such other order/orders, directions as this Hon'ble Court deems fit in the circumstances of the case, in the interest of justice and equity."

3. On the basis of the complaint filed by the victim/complainant/respondent No.2, Kalaburagi City Women Police have registered the case in Crime No.86/2025 against accused Nos.1 to 3 for the commission of offences under Sections 376(2)(n), 384, 504, 506, 109 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 67A of the Information Technology Act, 2008.

After investigation, the Investigation Officer has submitted the chargesheet against accused Nos.1 to 3.
4.
The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners would submit that absolutely there are no materials against these petitioners for the alleged commission of offences.

Respondent No.1/jurisdictional police while submitting the chargesheet have not made any efforts to ascertain as to how the provisions of the NC: 2026:KHC-K:2028 HC-KAR offences alleged are applicable as against the petitioners, as there is no statement recorded from the complainant about the alleged involvement of the petitioners for the cause of offences and only statement made against the petitioners is based on hearsay statement without there being any supporting material evidence.
Therefore, involving the petitioners as accused Nos.2 and 3 is only to harass the entire family at the instance of the complainant and same cannot be sustained.

5. Further, he would submit that from reading of the entire complaint, there is no direct interaction except visit by the complainant along with her parents to the house of the petitioners to inform the illegality committed by accused No.1 and the complainant clearly speaks about the assurance given by the petitioners to resolve the issue.
However, the statement of alleged involvement is referring to the alleged statement of accused No.1 to involve the petitioners in the alleged crime.

Therefore, none Smt.Savitri @ Savitra vs The State Through on 3 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38854358/
3 of the provisions invoked by respondent No.1/police, NC: 2026:KHC-K:2028 HC-KAR as against the petitioners, are attracted so as to implicate them in the alleged crime attributed to accused No.1 and the proceedings initiated at the instance of respondent No.2/complainant as against the petitioners are requires to be set aside.
The entire chargesheet does not specify the provisions applicable as against the petitioners for their alleged involvement in the crime.
6. After investigation, the Investigation Officer has submitted the chargesheet against the accused for the aforesaid alleged commission of offences.

A perusal of the chargesheet, chargesheet materials and other prosecution papers, there is no direct interaction between the complainant and accused Nos.2 and 3, except visit by the Smt.Savitri @ Savitra vs The State Through on 3 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38854358/
4 complainant along with her parents to the house of the petitioners to inform the illegality committed by accused No.1.
The petitioners have not instigated accused No.1 for the alleged commission of offences.
On careful examination of the entire prosecution papers, I do not find any essential ingredients to attract the alleged commission of offences as against these petitioners.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER (a) The Criminal Petition is allowed.

NC: 2026:KHC-K:2028 HC-KAR (b) The proceedings in C.C.No.11680/2025, pending on the file of I Additional Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Kalaburagi registered by Kalaburagi City Women Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 384, 504, 506, 109 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 67A of the Information Technology Act, 2008 and the order of cognizance dated 25.10.2025 arising out of Crime No.86/2025 against the petitioners are quashed.
